ck_goods_receipt_lines_dates.name: ck_goods_receipt_lines_dates
ck_goods_receipt_lines_dates.value: "goods_receipt_lines"."expires_on" is null or "goods_receipt_lines"."manufactured_on" is null or "goods_receipt_lines"."expires_on" > "goods_receipt_lines"."manufactured_on"

ck_goods_receipts_posted.name: ck_goods_receipts_posted
ck_goods_receipts_posted.value: "goods_receipts"."status" in ('draft','cancelled') or ("goods_receipts"."posted_at" is not null and "goods_receipts"."posted_by" is not null)

ck_goods_receipts_reversed.name: ck_goods_receipts_reversed
ck_goods_receipts_reversed.value: "goods_receipts"."status" <> 'reversed' or ("goods_receipts"."reversed_at" is not null and "goods_receipts"."reversal_reason" is not null)

ck_goods_receipts_cancelled.name: ck_goods_receipts_cancelled
ck_goods_receipts_cancelled.value: "goods_receipts"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("goods_receipts"."cancelled_at" is not null and "goods_receipts"."cancel_reason" is not null)

ck_quality_holds_closed.name: ck_quality_holds_closed
ck_quality_holds_closed.value: ("quality_holds"."status" = 'closed') = ("quality_holds"."closed_by" is not null and "quality_holds"."closed_at" is not null and "quality_holds"."resolution" is not null)
